label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 104 ]

blocks.text: Mexico attracts different types of visitors.
One group is composed of artists. As admirers of the Mexican culture,
they want to be close to the subjects they are writing about or
painting. Another group consists of retirees who also need to live on
reduced incomes. They like the unhurried way of life with its long
afternoon nap and they enjoy the temperate climate. The third group is
attracted by the resort with its colorful night life. In Acapulco, they can
play all night, and swim in the warm ocean water.

readingSentences.english: Millions of tourists visit Mexico every year.
readingSentences.korean: 수백만 명의 관광객이 매년 멕시코를 방문한다.

readingSentences.english: They are interested in the country's rich history and diverse culture.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 멕시코의 풍부한 역사와 다채로운 문화에 큰 관심을 가지고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Many come to explore the magnificent Mayan and Aztec ruins.
readingSentences.korean: 많은 이들이 웅장한 마야와 아즈텍 유적지를 탐험하기 위해 찾아온다.

readingSentences.english: Others prefer the sunny beaches and warm coastal waters of Cancun and Cozumel.
readingSentences.korean: 다른 사람들은 칸쿤과 코수멜의 화창한 해변과 따뜻한 해안 바다를 더 선호한다.

readingSentences.english: A third group is drawn to the vibrant nightlife and luxury resorts of Acapulco.
readingSentences.korean: 세 번째 집단은 화려한 밤 문화와 아카풀코의 고급 휴양지들에 매료된 사람들이다.

readingSentences.english: In Acapulco, they can dance until dawn and swim in pleasant ocean breezes.
readingSentences.korean: 아카풀코에서 그들은 새벽까지 춤추며 놀 수 있고 쾌적한 바닷바람 속에서 수영을 즐길 수 있다.
